title: Corrección crítica: OAuth/business auto-provisión, persistencia de chat y contexto Vitanova
description: Concilio ordena: (1) corregir URIs de redirect OAuth y crear business por defecto vía trigger al registrarse por Google; (2) persistir historial de chat en Supabase (conversations/messages) y restaurarlo al recargar; (3) inyectar contexto de Vitanova por defecto en la sesión activa sin configuración manual

classification.rationale: Classified as COMPLEX complexity. Complexity drivers: 10 files affected, schema changes required, AI behaviour changes, security implications, cross-cutting (multi-domain), category requires council. Required agents (12): architect, database, backend, frontend, ai_engineer, performance, security, qa, release, infrastructure_bootstrap, infrastructure_guardian, memory_engineer.
